cat > /workspace/project/README.md <<'MDEOF'
# CPU policy agent

`driver.py` is the collected JSON entry point: one request on standard input,
one response on standard output, exit 0. `python3 /workspace/launch.py
< request.json` runs it with the pinned offline dependency path.

## Layout

| file | role |
|---|---|
| `driver.py` | entry point: reads stdin, streams the response, owns nothing else |
| `envelope.py` | strict JSON text rules (BOM, whitespace, depth 64, duplicate keys, non-finite numbers, 4300-digit integers, 24 MiB input, at most 4 jobs) |
| `validate.py` | job/event schema, service registry and limits, and the whole-request policy budgets (200000 events, 16 stages, 8 MiB policy bytes, 32768 atom occurrences, 65536 path-service occurrences) counted over structurally valid jobs only |
| `syntax.py` | policy language: tokenizer, grammar, predicate depth and per-string policy bounds; returns rules plus occurrence counts and the registry check |
| `compiler/automata.py` | fast canonical machine: residual automata per atom, joint product, Moore partition refinement, dead-residual removal, breadth-first labelling and the row/cell census |
| `compiler/compiler.py` | the same language semantics built on real FAdo automata (epsilon NFAs, FAdo subset construction, FAdo Brzozowski minimization) as an oracle that shares the canonical writer |
| `ebpf/create_dfa.py` | state exporter: policy text plus registry in, canonical image out |
| `ebpf/helper.py` | CPU map backend (`MemoryMap`) and the `Agent` that implements the full lifecycle, transactions, references and census |

No kernel attachment, service deployment, network, subprocess, thread or
external state is involved; nothing outside the process memory is touched and
only `/workspace/tmp` would ever be writable.

## What the repair does

* **Canonical images.** An image is the minimal deterministic complete machine
  of the policy language after removal of its dead residual, with START always
  retained, residuals numbered by breadth-first discovery over increasing
  service-label columns ignoring `DENY = 4294967295`, and `accept[s]` the
  allowedness of the *complete* history reaching label `s`. Empty languages
  collapse to one false flag and one all-`DENY` row; all-allow to one true flag
  and a row of zeroes. Stages producing more than 8192 rows are rejected.
  `startswith`, `endswith`, `contains` and `match` all treat their path as a
  sequence of services, and the empty path matches every sequence except the
  exact-match atom, which matches only the empty sequence.
* **Language semantics.** `allowed(w) == (some allow rule matches w) and (no
  drop rule matches w)`; with no allow rules the language is empty (the starter
  raised instead). Legacy grammar defects are gone: paths may be empty, only
  the five documented whitespace characters are ignored, vertical tab and other
  Unicode whitespace are syntax errors, and every declared bound is enforced.
* **Atomic publication.** `stage` compiles first and only then installs the
  image, its map cells and its epoch high-water mark; capacities (resident
  images and cells over all resident images) are checked before the first
  mutation. `commit` may point at any resident epoch, `retire` removes an
  inactive image with zero references, and the stage epoch mark never goes down.
* **Pinned versions.** Contexts, packets and files store `(epoch, state)` and
  advance through *that* epoch's machine, never the active one. `DENY` is
  sticky, a denied context still consumes a context slot and holds a reference.
* **Exact accounting.** One image reference per live context copy, retained
  packet or current file; units, active pointers and receipts hold none.
  Packets keep their reference after delivery. Every counter, high-water mark
  and capacity check is all-or-nothing.
* **Handoffs.** `send` stamps the 24-byte `EMC4` wire (`4s, u32 epoch, u32
  source state, u32 destination label, u32 stream, u32 connection generation`,
  network byte order, lowercase hex). `recv` is idempotent only for the same
  live `(unit, rid)` context of the same packet. `store`/`load` model an
  explicit last-writer storage handoff; `clone` copies a whole context table by
  value while inheriting the service and the request mark.
* **Bounded output.** Responses are streamed through a bounded buffer, so a
  legal batch whose compact response is over 100 MiB (200000 events against 16
  resident images) stays far below the 256 MiB stdout cap and the 2 GiB address
  space.

## Verification

* `python3 /workspace/public_check.py` as the nonroot user: real bounded child
  CLI processes, the manual fixture, and JSON transport/validation.
* `EMICRO_VERIFY=1` makes the exporter compile every policy with both the fast
  engine and the FAdo reference and refuse to publish unless they agree cell
  for cell; the default runs leave the reference out of the hot path.
MDEOF
